QF.id: XVI Code of Conduct and Investor Protection_17

question.text: Recorded dealing-room lines and order evidence maintained by trading members must be preserved:

answer.text: For the minimum period notified for arbitration complaints, and disputed records until final resolution of the dispute
Only for one month after the trade date
Only until the next financial year

explanation.text: The Logic: Voice recordings of dealing-room lines and other order evidence must be maintained for the notified minimum period applicable to arbitration complaints. Where a dispute has been raised, the relevant records must be retained until final resolution of that dispute. The Trap: The source ties retention to the notified arbitration-complaint period and to ongoing disputes, not to a fixed one-month window, an across-the-board "no records" position, or a financial-year cut-off. Note: Clients should also keep their own independent records — contract notes, statements, and margin reports — rather than relying solely on the broker's archives.
